body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LUMION introduced ‘LUMION 210WT’, 20.1-inch wide LCD monitor built-in TV tuner in Korea market. It is equipped with LG Philips original panel, TV tuner, speakers which enables users to watch TV without PC. Also you can mount easily on the wall with its smart arrangement of VESA.
